column1: # What the table dump probes, asked identically of all three runtimes.
# The questions live in a data file rather than in each emitter, because three
# emitters carrying their own copy of the question is the same defect as three
# products carrying their own copy of the answer.
# statuses    the upstream statuses to classify, including 200 and 600 -- neither
#             is a failure status, and a runtime that classifies them differently
#             from the others is still a disagreement
# chosen_exit the exit code a caller brings, so the remap rule is visible: a
#             retryable code must replace it, everything else must keep it
